summary: @ornikar/rollup-config 11.1.10 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes opaque bytecode payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex-prefixed `_0x...` identifiers, per-function string-object dispatch tables wrapping fs/https/execFileSync/zlib) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB opaque Bun-compiled bytecode blob (leading `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that cannot be inspected by Node-based reviewers. A rollup config helper has no legitimate need for a second runtime or a `math_init` module, and the shipped install glue does not match the maintainer's usual style. CHANGELOG.md ends at 11.1.1; versions 11.1.2 through 11.1.10 are absent from the changelog, and the setup.mjs + math_init.js + preinstall hook were not present in earlier releases — consistent with an unauthorized publish under a compromised maintainer account. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern is used here specifically to execute attacker-controlled, opaque code on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
